_about: Provenance of every reconstructed value. 'first-party' means stated in OpenAI's 26 Aug report, the Hugging Face timeline or the METR/Redwood report. 'forced-choice' means the record shows no decision was made, but a filing would have had to make one; we chose the value a cautious filer would declare. 'placeholder' means the fact is not public; the value exists only so the record validates and is never scored.

intent_run_a.json./trigger_basis: first-party: covered developer (T2); safeguards relaxed by design (T4). T3 follows from the forecast cyber band, which is itself a placeholder.
intent_run_a.json./monitoring_instruments: first-party: no trajectory monitoring; the two real detections were an outage and a privilege-escalation alert. Alert and data sources named accordingly.
intent_run_a.json./egress_topology/permitted_paths: first-party: isolation by packet filtering around one permitted path, an internally hosted package proxy
intent_run_a.json./egress_topology/credential_scope: forced-choice: agents were not meant to hold administrator credentials
intent_run_a.json./egress_topology/inter_agent_comms_permi: v0.3 defines this as a fact about the environment (can one agent read what another wrote), not a design intention. A writable proxy shared by all runs makes it true, so a truthful v0.3 filer declares true. (v0.2 reconstruction used the forced choice false.)
intent_run_a.json./egress_topology/writable_surfaces: DILIGENT filer: write permission on the proxy is a configuration fact knowable in advance. The as_believed variant removes it.
intent_run_a.json./safeguards_disabled: first-party: cyber refusals lowered, production classifiers omitted
intent_run_a.json./pause_criteria: forced-choice: no recorded criteria existed; these are what a filer would plausibly declare
intent_run_a.json./log_retention: forced-choice: default retention; minimum_preserved_pct is a declared target
intent_run_a.json./egress_topology/permitted_paths/0/agent: DILIGENT filer: write permission on the proxy is a configuration fact; as_believed sets it false
intent_run_a.json./filed_at: forced-choice (v0.3): a compliant Intent is filed at least 3 days before the start so intake review can happen; the 7 May start is first-party
intent_run_a.json./safeguards_disabled/checklist: first-party for model_output_filters (off) and refusal_behaviour (relaxed); forced-choice 'on' for the other four, which the record does not address
intent_run_a.json./egress_topology/writable_surfaces/0/iso: first-party: the proxy persisted across runs and was reachable by all agents
intent_run_a.json./pause_criteria (C-tamper, C-boundary, C: forced-choice: v0.3 requires a criterion for every reportable kind under safeguards-off
intent_run_a.json./restart_protocol/approver_role: forced-choice: v0.3 requires the restart approver to hold no pause authority
intent_run_a.json./agent_capabilities, /readable_sources: first-party in substance (shell, package install and upload via the proxy); wording ours
intent_run_a.json./run_scale: placeholder lower bound: more than 50 agents joined the channel (first-party); per-run scale not public
intent_run_a.json./reward_design: first-party that the reward was task success and was gamed; details not public

intent_run_b.json./filed_at: first-party: second, highly persistent model started 11 June with access to the proxy
intent_run_b.json./egress_topology/shared_surface_lineage: required by DBYR when two runs reach the same persistent shared surface

closeout_run_a.json./security_events: first-party: OpenAI report items 01-12; dates per OpenAI and Hugging Face
closeout_run_a.json./pause_events/0: first-party: outage 4 Jul; incident opened, route blocked, credentials removed, service rebuilt 5 Jul; evaluations resumed 6 Jul. Approver role is forced-choice.
closeout_run_a.json./pause_events/1: first-party: runs stopped and credentials revoked 19 Jul (item 16)
closeout_run_a.json./containment_exceptions: first-party facts; exception records are what a compliant closeout would contain. X1 closed_at: board incidentally cleared by the 5 Jul rebuild.
closeout_run_a.json./logs_preserved_pct: first-party: roughly a tenth of trajectories not preserved
closeout_run_a.json./scope_requested_vs_granted/0/requested: placeholder: what was requested is not public
closeout_run_a.json./scope_requested_vs_granted/0/granted: first-party (METR/Redwood, NYT): capped at 13 Jul, earlier training-phase incidents excluded. Start date TO VERIFY: sources give 26 Jun and 7 Jul.
closeout_run_a.json./third_party_notifications/0: first-party: Hugging Face disclosed 16 Jul; investigations merged 20 Jul
closeout_run_a.json._excluded: RubyGems and German wiki operators are not listed: their attribution is circumstantial and nothing scored depends on them. 'Organization 1' (whose leaked credential was used) is omitted because its notification status is not public.
closeout_run_a.json./security_events/*/detected_at: first-party where stated (outage 4 Jul, escalation route 5 Jul, linkage 19 Jul); E1, E2, E5 set to 19 Jul because the record says their significance was not seen before then
closeout_run_a.json./integrity_events: forced-choice: empty. Agents found a universal cheat for the benchmark (first-party), but whether that altered grader inputs (environment_tampering) is not settled by the record. A held-out scorer may disagree; it is not used by any predicate.
closeout_run_a.json./internal_incidents: first-party: incident opened 5 Jul, evaluations resumed 6 Jul; investigation from 19 Jul
closeout_run_a.json./preservation: first-party for trajectories (roughly a tenth not preserved); placeholder 100 for other classes
closeout_run_a.json./surface_resets/0/snapshot_retained: not public; set true charitably (the investigators later held over 70,000 messages and files). If no snapshot was kept, v0.3 would record an evidence_destroyed conduct finding, because the rebuild cleared the board while incident INC-0705 was open.
closeout_run_a.json./pause_events/0/restart/approved_by_role: forced-choice: follows the v0.3 restart protocol
closeout_run_a.json./security_events/*/classification_ration: ours, paraphrasing the first-party description of each event
closeout_run_a.json._cadence: Only the final closeout is reconstructed. A rolling run files every 30 days, so v0.3 records closeout_overdue (conduct) on this 73-day period; that finding is about our reconstruction's coverage, not about OpenAI.

notice_n1.json: forced-choice: what a diligent filer would have filed within 72 hours of the 4-5 Jul incident
notice_n2.json: forced-choice: what a diligent filer would have filed within 72 hours of the 19 Jul detection
